headline: Strategic Base Turnover Escalates Across Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the pace of strategic‑base exchanges has risen sharply on the most contested sectors. Weathered Expanse now records forty‑two flips in the past 24 hours, adding roughly 13,600 Colonial and 16,700 Warden casualties, while enlistments there accelerate to 51 per hour. Fishermans Row remains the busiest theatre with fifty‑seven flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia and Fort Ember, and both sides suffering several thousand new casualties. Stlican Shelf has climbed to thirty‑six flips across Thornhold, The Pale House, Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn, with casualties surpassing 3,600 Colonial and 5,000 Warden in the last day. Mooring County and Linn Mercy have each surged to nineteen and eighteen daily flips respectively, fresh events logged at filing time. Farranac Coast holds fourteen flips and Stonecradle twelve, both showing renewed activity. Enlistment rates are accelerating in all of these zones, signalling fresh manpower feeding the exchanges. Quieter fronts such as Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields and the northern Warden‑held regions show no new flips and only marginal casualty changes.
